definitions.actors_for_50pct_pushes: smallest number of non-obvious-bot PushEvent actors whose PushEvents make up at least half of a repository's Jan-Aug total
definitions.benchmark_selection: top 100 repositories by July 2026 OpenRank within the OpenDigger technology label, excluding repositories already assigned to an earlier cohort

limitations: PushEvent actors are pushers, not commit authors, and one push may carry several commits.
Bot exclusion uses public login patterns; service accounts without those patterns can remain.
The cohorts describe active head projects in each label, not every repository in the domain.
